sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite. Hydrating whole-fruit package. Water and whole-food structure make it easier to use well than juice or sweets. Ingredient simplicity is hard to argue with. Whole-fruit clarity is part of the category appeal.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: usually used in tiny amounts. That limits how much of the vitamin C and polyphenol upside you actually get per use. Easy to eat quickly when it is very sweet. That can blur the line between light and sugar-heavy portions. Hard to use as a main food. It usually acts as a flavour tool, not something eaten in volume.

closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, protein, and vitamin C, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, low fat quality, and low protein quality. It is good for low-calorie volume and immune support because it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure and vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
